name: Dublin City University
description: Dublin City University (DCU) is a pioneering public university founded in Ireland in 1980. DCU, Dublin City University is a university among Ireland's schools that provides high quality education within the framework of its economic and social needs. Dublin City University has more than 100 teaching programs in different subjects and fields that it offers to students in undergraduate and graduate education. Dublin City University has 2,000 international students from 114 countries in 2018. Dublin City University's undergraduate and postgraduate courses cater to students from across Ireland as well as a large number of international students.
